ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Cloud Computing Infrastructure. Prerequistites: ECE 438 and ECE413. ECE534 is preferable. The success of Web 2.0 applications is motivating a paradigm shift in the design of computational infrastructure towards the so-called cloud-based model. This course covers topics in the system and algorithmic design of cloud computing infrastructure including data center network and file system, map-reduce framework, straggler mitigation, load balancing, massive data collection and energy-efficient computation.
